invariants.rationale: Collectors.toList() never returns null; the result is a non-null list.
Each 'id' in result is derived from smallFile.location.getFileId(), which should produce non-null file ids for valid SmallFile entries.
Each smallFile in smallFiles maps to exactly one file id in result; the mapping is one-to-one.
The number of distinct elements cannot exceed the total number of elements; ensures uniqueness bounds.
File IDs are expected to be non-empty strings; isEmpty would indicate a problematic file id.
